answer: Counterparty-diversity thresholds stop sybil self-trading rings. Each epoch every agent must trade with 50 distinct counterparties. The market is a meadow of 100,000 agents, so honest agents clear the bar in normal trade. Sybils cannot wander through real demand: 1,000 fakes need 50 real partners each, costing $1M in fees, while one honest agent pays $1,000. Only qualifiers step onto the settlement terrace, where rewards are issued; fakes never climb up.
